app.title: Memdoor: A team of 5 Qwen3.8-27B models beats Fable 5 on LiveCodeBench Hard
app.author: guregodevo
app.description: Memdoor is a workflow orchestration framework that chains multiple Qwen models to solve coding challenges, achieving state‑of‑the‑art results on the LiveCodeBench Hard benchmark.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and install dependencies via pip install -e .
Run the example workflow from examples/workflows/team-solve and verify that the generated code passes the LiveCodeBench Hard tests.
Measure end‑to‑end execution time of the workflow and compare against the baseline reported in the paper.
Execute a single‑model run using the default Qwen3.8-27B and confirm that the output is valid Python code.
